browser_proof.fallback: After the local server stopped between captures, the Browser entered its connection-error page and its URL policy blocked a return to localhost. The task explicitly permits Playwright; repository Playwright completed the corrected responsive and appearance matrix.

observations: A real searchable PDF was generated from invented text and parsed in the browser workflow.
Generic all-addenda language remained REVIEW because it did not visibly name the identifier.
The first full validation stopped on two unformatted Markdown files; formatting was applied and the complete validation then passed.
Initial dependency resolutions exposed current glob, browser-install, Vite, and Vitest advisories; patched locked versions and transitive overrides reduced npm audit to zero vulnerabilities.
Manual screenshot inspection found a low-readability emulated light-hover state; explicit light and dark hover tokens fixed it, and the new axe and screenshot proof passed.
No warnings were suppressed. The Playwright runner removes conflicting inherited color-control variables before spawning so Node emits no irrelevant NO_COLOR/FORCE_COLOR warning.

warning_issue_triage.details: Formatting, dependency, test-boundary, type, hover-readability, and Browser-fallback issues are recorded above. All release gates now pass.
